expected_result: Exit 0 when the projection regenerates with no diff, every declared input resolves, and every superseded document declares itself superseded.
title: Current-state projection freshness check
description: Regenerates the canonical current-state projection from its declared controlling inputs and compares it, its input fingerprint, and the superseded-document markers. Replaces the WP-006 declared-binding guard, which bound documents to a commit hash and went stale after every legitimate change (FND-011).
supports: Whether the canonical current-state document is the deterministic projection of its declared controlling inputs at this tree.
does_not_support: The correctness or authority of any statement inside the projection, and merge enforcement of the check.
